basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Serving officers of the Maharashtra Government holding a post in the same pay band and grade pay, at minimum Deputy Secretary in Mantralaya or an equivalent pay scale (S-25)
qualification.details: Qualification: Officer in State Government service holding a post of at least Deputy Secretary in Mantralaya, or an equivalent pay scale (S-25), with the same pay band and grade pay | Other conditions: | Officer must hold the same pay band and grade pay as Deputy Secretary in Mantralaya (S-25). Officer must not have been on deputation in the last 3 years; 3 years must have passed since return from the previous deputation. how_to_apply: Interested eligible officers should send one copy of the application, with the service details form, to their own administrative department.
Send one copy of the application to the Environment and Climate Change Department as well.
Both copies must be sent within 21 days, by Monday 16-11-2026.
Fill in the service details form given on page 3 of the notice.
important_instructions: Departments are asked to bring the notice to the attention of eligible officers in their offices and subordinate offices. The form asks whether the department will release the officer if selected, and whether any departmental inquiry or criminal case is pending.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officer in State Government service holding a post of at least Deputy Secretary in Mantralaya, or an equivalent pay scale (S-25), with the same pay band and grade pay Other conditions: Officer must hold the same pay band and grade pay as Deputy Secretary in Mantralaya (S-25). Officer must not have been on deputation in the last 3 years; 3 years must have passed since return from the previous deputation. Total deputation tenure must not exceed 10 years, including earlier deputations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation for an initial period of 3 years, extendable as per the Government Resolution. Pay and allowances will be paid from the funds of the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board.

content_sections.heading: How Will Environment and Climate Change Department Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Deputation selection as per General Administration Department rules.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Service details form (page 3 of the notice) Summary copy of confidential reports for the last 5 years; do not send the original reports Property and liabilities return status Permanent (confirmation) certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Environment and Climate Change Department Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Interested eligible officers should send one copy of the application, with the service details form, to their own administrative department. Send one copy of the application to the Environment and Climate Change Department as well. Both copies must be sent within 21 days, by Monday 16-11-2026. Fill in the service details form given on page 3 of the notice.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Departments are asked to bring the notice to the attention of eligible officers in their offices and subordinate offices. The form asks whether the department will release the officer if selected, and whether any departmental inquiry or criminal case is pending.
